notes.title: Without Escape 50% off!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Halloween is here! Maybe you want to celebrate it by playing a horror point and click graphic adventure? If that's the case, Without Escape is now 50% off on Steam!


If you go for it, I hope you like it!

notes.title: New trailer and release date!
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last time I posted here, but I've been working on Without Escape, polishing the game and all that.

And today I'm proud to announce that the game will be released on April 24 and it will cost $4.89 during the first week (30% discount). The game will return to its original price of $6.99 a week later.

The original soundtrack of the game will be also available for those who enjoy its music; it will cost $1.99.

You can also check the new trailer on the Steam page or on Youtube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAW30U0kxRk]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAW30U0kxRk[/url]

I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Adding dynamism to static backgrounds
notes.content:
I wrote an article in my blog about one of the tricks I use to add dynamism to static pre-rendered backgrounds. Making them a little bit more dynamic helps to express the intended mood for that room better.

Please check it out!

notes.title: Without Escape Announcement!
notes.content:
Without Escape is a point and click horror graphic adventure. It is inspired by those first person graphic adventures with pre-rendered backgrounds from the 90s.

It is still in development and I plan to release it this year. If you like retro point and click adventures, please check it out!
